evals.prompt: 帮我在 zlibrary 上找一下刘慈欣《三体》的 epub，前 5 个结果就够，挑分数最高的那本给我。
evals.expected_output: Invoke skills/holo-zlib/scripts/zlib.py search with the query and --ext epub --limit 5; the output surfaces book_id/hash for a later download.
assertions: Agent invokes skills/holo-zlib/scripts/zlib.py search (via python3/python) with the query containing 三体
Agent does not prompt the user for clarifying info before calling the search
Response mentions book_id and hash from the search results (or explicitly reports a network/script failure and how to retry)

evals.prompt: ok 就下第一本吧，默认位置就行。book_id 我刚才看到是 1234567，hash 是 abc123def。
evals.expected_output: Invoke skills/holo-zlib/scripts/zlib.py download 1234567 abc123def, saving to the default ebooks/ directory, and report progress and the final file path.
assertions: Agent invokes skills/holo-zlib/scripts/zlib.py download (via python3/python) with positional args 1234567 and abc123def in that order
Agent does not pass --output (because the user said the default location is fine)
Agent does not prompt the user for clarifying info before running the download
Response reports either the successful save path OR the failure mode (invalid hash / network error) in a way the user can act on

evals.prompt: can you grab me a pdf of 'Designing Data-Intensive Applications'? just the most popular one, I don't care about year.
evals.expected_output: Even without naming Z-Library, recall this skill; invoke skills/holo-zlib/scripts/zlib.py search with --ext pdf; do not mangle the English book title.
assertions: Agent invokes skills/holo-zlib/scripts/zlib.py search (via python3/python) — i.e. recognizes this as a Z-Library lookup even though 'Z-Library' is not named
Search query contains the English book title 'Designing Data-Intensive Applications' (no machine-translated variant)
Agent does not prompt the user for clarifying info (year/author) before running the search
Response identifies a single recommended result (or explicitly reports search failure)
